description: Central Bank of Sri Lanka - Amendment to the Money Broking Regulations No. 01 of 2018
categorisation: This gazette contains amendments to financial regulations (Money Broking Regulations) made by the Monetary Board of the Central Bank of Sri Lanka under the Monetary Law Act. It establishes regulatory requirements for money broking companies, including compliance procedures, reporting obligations, and qualification standards. This falls under Legal/Regulatory Gazettes as it deals with regulatory frameworks and compliance requirements in the financial sector.
